metas.name: Premada Oorali
metas.description: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

metas.name: Just Maath Maathalli
metas.description: Siddharth, a singer, embarks on a journey to Singapore to meet and confess his love for Tanu. He meets Adi, a scriptwriter, on his flight and starts narrating the story of his life.

metas.name: Brindavihari
metas.description: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

metas.name: Upasane
metas.description: Shraddha is a music enthusiast. She is determined to pursue a career in classical music but faces several obstacles.

metas.name: Janapada
metas.description: Janapada tells the story of folk singer Chandranna, who feels that singing and entertaining people is better than any recognition from the government. His singing attracts many people including a city-bred girl who decides to stay in the village to be close to him. Meanwhile, Chandranna receives an award from the government, which makes him a target of envy. The village head, priest and a rival singer plot to defame the singer by spreading rumours about him. They even impose a ban on the singer to keep him away from the public.

metas.name: Blink
metas.description: Apoorva, a 24-year-old in Bengaluru, conceals his failed MA from his mother. Juggling part-time jobs, he relies on his love interest, Swapna, for support. Apoorva's unique ability to control blinking becomes a curse when a mysterious old man reveals his father's survival.

metas.name: Orchestra Mysuru
metas.description: The film follows a young man from Mysore with a dream to become a singer in the local orchestras. Can he triumphs over all difficulties to make his dream come true?

metas.name: Dance Raja Dance
metas.description: Raja, a talented but poor cobbler and break dancer, dreams of stardom. He falls for Radha, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, J.J.. Their romance faces obstacles, including a past incident that causes Raja's mother to demand they break up, and Raja's vow to get revenge on the man who killed his father, who turns out to be Radha's father.

metas.name: My Autograph
metas.description: The story revolves around Shankar, working in an advertising agency who comes to his village to invite his friends to his marriage. He remembers the good old days and also sees how his friends are faring now. All this is told in flashback.

metas.name: Sri Manjunatha
metas.description: Manjunatha, an atheist, fights against social evils. He marries Kathyayini, a staunch devotee of Lord Shiva. As the days go by, Manjunatha realizes the existence of God.

metas.name: Mungaru Male
metas.description: Preetham loves Nandhini, whose marriage is already fixed. He feels bad and leaves the place. Nandini challenges him to win her heart. Preetham accepts the challenge.

metas.name: Sanaadi Appanna
metas.description: Based on a novel of same name by K Puranik, which is loosely based on real life events of Appanna, a rural shehnai artist from Karnataka. Appanna,  falls in love with a dancer, Basanti. But when Basanti dies, things changes a lot for Appanna.

metas.name: Abba! Aa Hudugi
metas.description: A trend-setting Kannada hit, loosely based on William Shakespeare's The Taming Of The Shrew

metas.name: Kaviratna Kalidasa
metas.description: Sanskrit and upper-caste poet, Kalidas, faces many challenges after falling in love with a low-caste woman, and being entered into a competition against a learned princess.
